name: Launch Saas
description: Orchestrates the full process of launching a SaaS product from system architecture through production monitoring, chaining seven software-development skills into a cohesive build-and-deploy pipeline. Use when the user wants to build and launch a SaaS application from scratch or migrate a prototype to production-ready infrastructure. Do NOT use for single-page static sites, internal tools without user authentication, or mobile-only apps without a web backend.
